ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and track the flow of federal funds to the state.
questions: What are the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold state officials accountable. I recommend starting with a review of public records and interviewing state officials.
